summary: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corp Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching its Q1 2026 earnings press release. The filing reports quarterly results—revenue $130.8M (up 30% YoY), EPS $0.05 (up 171% YoY), and notes a $34.1M rights offering completed in the prior quarter. No special-situation event—M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, or restructuring—is disclosed. The foreign private issuer is merely reporting routine financial performance under 13a-16. This is a standard earnings update with no transactional catalyst.
